title: Halliburton introduces RangeStar™ Geothermal Well Spacing and Intercept Service
summary: Halliburton launches next-gen magnetic ranging solution that supports geothermal development through faster, more accurate, and fully integrated well placement.
body_markdown:
#### RangeStar™ Geothermal Well Spacing and Intercept Service


Unlock geothermal energy potential through geothermal ranging that delivers fast surveys, accurate spacing, and continuous drilling optimization


[Explore](https://www.halliburton.com/en/products/rangestar-geothermal-well-spacing-intercept-service.html)


#### Geothermal energy


Halliburton delivers a low cost per megawatt in geothermal well construction by driving efficiencies in asset development, from field exploration through field optimization


[Explore](https://www.halliburton.com/en/low-carbon-solutions/geothermal.html)


#### iStar® intelligent drilling and logging platform


Fully digital and web-enabled to monitor and control drilling and logging operations from anywhere


[Explore](https://www.halliburton.com/en/products/istar-intelligent-drilling-and-logging-platform.html)


#### Magnetic ranging solutions


Magnetic ranging solutions demonstrate a well-established history of expertise, proving our dedication to precision when navigating the intricacies of well proximity applications


[Explore](https://www.halliburton.com/en/well-construction/magnetic-ranging-solutions.html)


#### LOGIX™ drilling automation and remote operations


Increase the consistency and performance of well construction operations by integrating subsurface automation, digital twins, and remote operations


[Explore](https://www.halliburton.com/en/well-construction/automation-and-remote-operations.html)


#### iCruise® intelligent rotary steerable system


Reduce well time through fast drilling, fast tripping time and quicker casing drill outs


[Explore](https://www.halliburton.com/en/products/icruise-intelligent-rotary-steerable-system.html)
